'''Executive Advisor''' was a position held by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. He served the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] and [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]] by special appointment as an elder statesman.
